title: Nanofat on Wound Healing and Scar Formation
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the effectiveness and safety of intradermal injection of Nanofat on wound healing and scar formation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- scheduled for DIEP-flap breast reconstruction surgery at our department

Exclusion Criteria:

* smokers
* use of cortisone or other immunsuppressants
* diabetes mellitus type 1 or 2
* age
* connective tissue disease
